campaign_name: Unit-of-Work v3.1 Milestone 4: Independent Rust Runtime Qualification (Levels 0-2)
claim: Rust is an independently executing UoW runtime qualified for canonical Level-0 semantics, transactional authority, crash replay, and deterministic DAG orchestration.
scope_boundary: Qualified through Levels 0, 1, and 2 (transition authority, OCC, deterministic sequencing, WAL replay, DAG orchestration). Autonomy, semantic mediation, learned proposers, economics, quorum, and physical hardware remain out of scope.

qualification_gates.name: Canonical 16/16 Semantic Vectors
qualification_gates.criteria: Independent native Rust runtime executes all 16 canonical golden vectors with identical disposition and state hashes without vector modification.

qualification_gates.name: OCC Conflict Equivalence
qualification_gates.criteria: Typed transaction footprints detect disjoint writes (ACCEPT), write/write collisions, write/read collisions, read/write hazards, and stale base sequence (REJECT).

qualification_gates.name: Deterministic Commit Sequencing
qualification_gates.criteria: Given identical initial state and transaction input sequence, committed sequence and state hashes are 100% invariant across repeated trials with zero wall-clock dependence.

qualification_gates.name: WAL Crash Replay Equivalence
qualification_gates.criteria: Replaying committed WAL records onto initial state reconstructs exact authoritative state (S_replayed = S_committed) and evidence ledger (E_replayed = E_committed); duplicate replay is idempotent.

qualification_gates.name: Deterministic DAG Orchestration
qualification_gates.criteria: Correct task eligibility frontier calculation (A,B -> B -> C -> D -> HALT), cycle detection defense, duplicate completion rejection, and dependency violation prevention.

qualification_gates.name: Proposer Non-Escalation & Zero Authority Boundary
qualification_gates.criteria: Runtime enforces Proposer != Authority: wrong route, stale pre-state, forged proposed state, invalid authority, and impossible mutation are strictly rejected.
